{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display basic info
data_info = sales_df.info()

# Display summary statistics
summary_stats = sales_df.describe(include='all')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Print results
top_rows, data_info, summary_stats, missing_values, duplicates"}
